I'll find the cart tests first, then run them to see which one fails.
The failing test is **`cart › applies the discount once to the subtotal`** (`test/cart.test.ts:9`).

It expects `cartTotal(items, 10)` to return `45`, but the code returns `40`. The subtotal is 10 + 40 = 50, and the 10% discount is 5. The bug is in `src/cart.ts:16`: `round2(subtotal - discount * items.length)` multiplies the discount by the number of line items (2 here), so the discount is taken twice (50 - 10 = 40). It should be `round2(subtotal - discount)`, which gives 45. The comment on line 15 already flags this.

The other two cart tests should pass: `lineTotal` gives 2.5 × 4 = 10, and the no-discount case gives 9.

One discrepancy: the Volt test run reported all three tests as **skipped**, not failed, and the file has no `.skip` markers. I didn't investigate why; the skip is probably coming from the runner or its config. I haven't changed any files.
